name: keepwarm
description: Keeps the session's prompt cache warm while you are away with one small request before it expires, for a set number of hours, and tells you when the cache has gone cold. Uses tokens: each ping is a model request that re-reads the conversation at the cached price.

enabled.title: Keep warm
enabled.description: After each turn, keep the prompt cache alive with a small request before it expires. Each one re-reads the whole context at the cache-read rate, so it costs usage while you are away.

hours.title: Hours to keep warm
hours.description: How long after your last turn the cache is kept warm before it is let go.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: How long the session's cache lives without a request. auto reads your promptCacheTtl setting, else assumes one hour on a Claude subscription and five minutes otherwise.

coldNote.title: Say when the cache is cold
coldNote.description: Show a line above the prompt once the cache has expired, with what the next turn will re-read.
